[Timeline](https://stackoverflow.com/posts/79044550/timeline) Show activity on this post. I'm trying to use pdfjs in a react+ts project. ```javascript Copy import React from "react"; import * as pdfjs from "pdfjs-dist" export default function EditPdf() { React.useEffect(()=>{ const doc = pdfjs.getDocument("helloworld.pdf"); doc.promise.then((pdf)=>{ console.log(pdf) }) },[]) return (
content
) } ``` Here I import it but I get the error: ```javascript Copy Error: No "GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc" specified. at get workerSrc (http://localhost:5173/node_modules/.vite/deps/pdfjs-dist.js?v=aab08523:12098:11) at _PDFWorker._initialize (http://localhost:5173/node_modules/.vite/deps/pdfjs-dist.js?v=aab08523:11983:7) at new _PDFWorker (http://localhost:5173/node_modules/.vite/deps/pdfjs-dist.js?v=aab08523:11956:10) at getDocument (http://localhost:5173/node_modules/.vite/deps/pdfjs-dist.js?v=aab08523:11120:69) at http://localhost:5173/src/EditPdf.tsx?t=1727811223984:24:17 at commitHookEffectListMount (http://localhost:5173/node_modules/.vite/deps/chunk-W6L2VRDA.js?v=2bfcffa6:16915:34) at invokePassiveEffectMountInDEV (http://localhost:5173/node_modules/.vite/deps/chunk-W6L2VRDA.js?v=2bfcffa6:18324:19) at invokeEffectsInDev (http://localhost:5173/node_modules/.vite/deps/chunk-W6L2VRDA.js?v=2bfcffa6:19701:19) at commitDoubleInvokeEffectsInDEV (http://localhost:5173/node_modules/.vite/deps/chunk-W6L2VRDA.js?v=2bfcffa6:19686:15) at flushPassiveEffectsImpl (http://localhost:5173/node_modules/.vite/deps/chunk-W6L2VRDA.js?v=2bfcffa6:19503:13) ``` Well online it seems "easy" enough... I can do something like: ```javascript Copy import pdfjsWorker from "pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.entry"; // ... pdfjs.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = pdfjsWorker ``` but `pdf.worker.entry` doesn't exist. I searched in the node\_modules folder and found a similarly named `pdf.worker.mjs` file. I tried to import with `import pfdjsWorker from "pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.entry"` but it cannot find the declaration for this. Finally I noticed that there exists a `pdfjs.PDFWorker` type declaration, but I am not sure how to use it (no documentation). How can I successfully import and use pdfjs + a worker in a React+TS proj? - [reactjs](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/reactjs "show questions tagged 'reactjs'") - [typescript](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/typescript "show questions tagged 'typescript'") - [pdf.js](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/pdf.js "show questions tagged 'pdf.js'") - [pdfjs-dist](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/pdfjs-dist "show questions tagged 'pdfjs-dist'") [Share](https://stackoverflow.com/q/79044550) Share a link to this question Copy link [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ "The current license for this post: CC BY-SA 4.0") Short permalink to this question [Improve this question](https://stackoverflow.com/posts/79044550/edit "") Follow Follow this question to receive notifications asked Oct 1, 2024 at 19:47 [![Null Salad's user avatar](https://i.sstatic.net/gMRgs.png?s=64)](https://stackoverflow.com/users/4382391/null-salad) [Null Salad](https://stackoverflow.com/users/4382391/null-salad) 1,08066 gold badges2525 silver badges4747 bronze badges [Add a comment](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/79044550/how-to-use-pdfjs-worker-in-react-and-typescript# "Use comments to ask for more information or suggest improvements. Avoid answering questions in comments.") \| [Expand to show all comments on this post](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/79044550/how-to-use-pdfjs-worker-in-react-and-typescript# "Expand to show all comments on this post") ## 6 Answers 6 Sorted by: [Reset to default](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/79044550/how-to-use-pdfjs-worker-in-react-and-typescript?answertab=scoredesc#tab-top) Highest score (default) Trending (recent votes count more) Date modified (newest first) Date created (oldest first) This answer is useful 6 This answer is not useful Save this answer. This worked for me: - Import the package as below import \* as pdfjsLib from "pdfjs-dist"; - Copy the pdf.worker.min.mjs file from node\_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/ directory into your public folder - Set the worker to point to the file in your public folder pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = window.location.origin + "/pdf.worker.min.mjs"; Helpful articles: [https://medium.com/@hesseclaus/using-pdfjs-with-react-app-rewired-f1f3a2527c45](https://medium.com/@hesseclaus/using-pdfjs-with-react-app-rewired-f1f3a2527c45) [https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/examples/index.html#interactive-examples](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/examples/index.html#interactive-examples) [Share](https://stackoverflow.com/a/79260237) Share a link to this answer Copy link [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ "The current license for this post: CC BY-SA 4.0") Short permalink to this answer [Improve this answer](https://stackoverflow.com/posts/79260237/edit "") Follow Follow this answer to receive notifications answered Dec 7, 2024 at 8:20 [![akanjimm's user avatar](https://www.gravatar.com/avatar/2738f33ec8d150a4d42dbb9dde1f212b?s=64&d=identicon&r=PG&f=y&so-version=2)](https://stackoverflow.com/users/15959805/akanjimm) [akanjimm](https://stackoverflow.com/users/15959805/akanjimm) 6611 silver badge66 bronze badges Sign up to request clarification or add additional context in comments. ## Comments Add a comment This answer is useful 3 This answer is not useful Save this answer. I'm also running pdfjs v4 in vite and found this works: ```javascript Copy import { GlobalWorkerOptions } from 'pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs'; GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = new URL('pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs', import.meta.url).toString(); ``` (We're running a legacy build, but I assume the main build works the same way) Vite won't recognise it's a js module and hence won't minify it, so I'm using the `min.mjs` version here. While dragging, use the arrow keys to move the item. Press space again to drop the item in its new position, or press escape to cancel. ### Description I create a simple demo, but it can't work. I use pnpm, vite@4, typescript. My code: ``` import { useState } from 'react' import { Document, Page } from 'react-pdf/dist/esm/entry.vite' import type { DocumentProps } from 'react-pdf' function App() { const [numPages, setNumPages] = useState(0) const [pageNumber] = useState(1) const onDocumentLoadSuccess: DocumentProps['onLoadSuccess'] = ({ numPages }) => { setNumPages(numPages) } return (

Page {pageNumber} of {numPages}

) } export default App ``` I get a 504 error when getting the `pdf.worker.js`: ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28031505/224597627-24a73036-0320-49b0-8005-dd3dbd7d5fc6.png) In the `.vite` dir, the bundle is: ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28031505/224597694-0dabdcb6-42d7-429b-8466-6a1a6858bde0.png) I also tried this: [#1148 (comment)](https://github.com/wojtekmaj/react-pdf/issues/1148#issuecomment-1314180559). But it's not good for me. By the way, the entry path in README is outdate. It's not `index.vite`, it's `entry.vite` now. ### Steps to reproduce A minimal reproduction is here: [https://github.com/Gu-Miao/react-pdf-test](https://github.com/Gu-Miao/react-pdf-test) ### Expected behavior Demo works fun ### Actual behavior Get a 504 error when getting `pdf.worker.js` ### Additional information _No response_ ### Environment - **Browser (if applicable)**: Chrome 110 - **React-PDF version**: 6.2.2 - **React version**: 18.2.0 - **Vite version**: 4.1.4 - **Pnpm version**: 7.29.1 👍React with 👍5itayper, nleroy917, boan-anbo, telcy and xavier-villelegier ## Activity [![](https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/28031505?s=64&u=e4b55c623356a30a4a2899fa97e25f04cd89e4ee&v=4)Gu-Miao](https://github.com/Gu-Miao) added [bugSomething isn't working](https://github.com/wojtekmaj/react-pdf/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22bug%22) Something isn't working [on Mar 12, 2023on Mar 12, 2023](https://github.com/wojtekmaj/react-pdf/issues/1377#event-8727183970) ### itayper commented on Mar 16, 2023on Mar 16, 2023 [![@itayper](https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/9265080?u=c64e095e7a6b64f2582e5c6dc51350135967dc1c&v=4&size=48)](https://github.com/itayper) [itayper](https://github.com/itayper) [on Mar 16, 2023on Mar 16, 2023](https://github.com/wojtekmaj/react-pdf/issues/1377#issuecomment-1471801514) More actions Having the same issue Tried to lower version to 6.0.2 as to when it was solved. [#1148 (comment)](https://github.com/wojtekmaj/react-pdf/issues/1148#issuecomment-1314180559) Couldn't get it to work. 👍React with 👍1EdenTurgeman ### EdenTurgeman commented on Mar 16, 2023on Mar 16, 2023 [![@EdenTurgeman](https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/12447231?u=2e90b49c549f4384e2c66bc19ae31dae86ab3eaf&v=4&size=48)](https://github.com/EdenTurgeman) [EdenTurgeman](https://github.com/EdenTurgeman) [on Mar 16, 2023on Mar 16, 2023](https://github.com/wojtekmaj/react-pdf/issues/1377#issuecomment-1471897277) Last edited by EdenTurgeman More actions Tried using it with vite 4 and got the same error. 😞 ### ChrisSamo632 commented on Mar 31, 2023on Mar 31, 2023 [![@ChrisSamo632](https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/12159006?u=c8578d012edbdce4c42a0537884ee76c2d3ebb78&v=4&size=48)](https://github.com/ChrisSamo632) [ChrisSamo632](https://github.com/ChrisSamo632) [on Mar 31, 2023on Mar 31, 2023](https://github.com/wojtekmaj/react-pdf/issues/1377#issuecomment-1491653442) More actions When I set an `onLoadError` event handler to display the `error.message` in a Vite setup (using the suggested `entry.vite` from the README.- note `entry` and **not**`index.vite`), I see the following returned: > Setting up fake worker failed: "Cannot load script at: [http://localhost:3000/node\_modules/.vite/deps/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.js](http://localhost:3000/node_modules/.vite/deps/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.js)". Looking in the `node_modules/.vite/deps` directory, there indeed isn't a `pdfjs-dist/` sub-directory (nevermind the rest). There is a `node_modules/.vite/deps/react-pdf_dist_esm_entry__vite.js` file (along with the same file with a `.maps` extension) - is this what should be referred to by `react-pdf` instead **or** is the required `pdf.worker.js` not being included in the `.vite/deps` as expected? In which case, where should it come from and how should it get here? N.B.
